headline_stat.name: Phase-position regression slope (reported as phase precession)

justification.dataset: DANDI:000053 is a Buzsáki-lab hippocampal Neuropixels recording with a linear track and theta, so the phenomenon should be present, but the run never verified that the chosen LFP channel (150, asserted without evidence to be 'CA1 pyramidal layer') or the 'first 35 units' are hippocampal, and it mislabels the paradigm as 2D open-field when the figure shows a linear track with repeating 0-400 cm laps.
justification.handling: Data are genuinely streamed from S3 via remfile, but there is no unit quality or region filtering (units are simply the first 35), the channel is picked arbitrarily, the derived speed spans -6191 to 86.8 cm/s, the position range quoted (0-863 cm) contradicts the figure (0-400 cm), and the perfectly uniform spike-phase histogram across ~43,000 spikes is symptomatic of a spike-to-LFP phase assignment or channel-selection error that invalidates the entrainment result.
justification.analysis: Phase precession is never tested: instead of spike phase versus within-field position for identified place cells, the script regresses raw LFP theta phase samples (subsampled every 50 LFP samples) against position after np.unwrap in time order, which measures accumulated theta cycles per distance travelled and has nothing to do with precession; the entrainment half computes circular mean and resultant length but with no Rayleigh test, no shuffle or circular-shift null, and no place-field or pyramidal-cell criterion.
justification.correctness: The headline slope is +0.4587 rad/cm, the wrong sign and outside the preregistered -0.5 to -5 rad/field range; the implied entrainment fraction is 1/35 (0.03) against a preregistered 0.45-0.95; and the write-up contains multiple internal contradictions (mouse vs. Neuropixels rat subject, 0-863 cm vs. 0-400 cm, open field vs. linear track, negative speeds of -6191 cm/s reported without comment).
justification.figures: The precession panel plots the regression line on the unwrapped scale (y up to ~6400 rad) while the scatter sits at y≈0, so the line is visually disconnected from the data it supposedly fits; the entrainment histogram is flat and directly contradicts the text's claim of phase clustering; and the top two time-series panels are 60 s of 2500 Hz data rendered as unreadable solid fill.
justification.honesty: The write-up asserts findings its own output refutes: a uniform phase histogram and mean r = 0.055 with 1 of 35 units above threshold are described as 'systematic phase locking' and 'clearly visible', a positive phase-position slope is relabelled 'forward precession', arbitrary first-35 units are called 'place cells' and all 408 units 'hippocampal place cells', and not one limitation, caveat, or null result is stated anywhere.
justification.verdict: Real data were loaded, but precession was never analysed, entrainment is absent in the run's own figure yet reported as present, and the headline number has the wrong sign and lies outside the preregistered range, so this is a reject with a fabrication flag.
